evals.prompt: Our odds feed contract renews in January. Should we sign three years with them?
evals.expected_output: A two-sided partner review with a tested-or-untested fallback.
expectations: Lists what we depend on the supplier for, spend and an owner
Writes what each side gives and a 12-month plan
Names a fallback with days to switch, marked tested or untested
Gives deepen, keep or loosen and leaves signing to the owner

evals.prompt: How much do we depend on the cloud provider, and how do we make that relationship stronger?
evals.expected_output: A dependency and fallback review that sends nothing.
expectations: States what the cloud provider provides and monthly spend, or marks a proposal
Names a fallback with days to switch
Sends no message and makes no commitment
Routes any hosting change through tailered-ai:workflow and the release coordinator on the owner's word
